{"proof":"  have hroots (x : ℝ) : (x + 3) ^ 2 = 121 ↔ x = 8 ∨ x = -14 := by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hf : (x - 8) * (x + 14) = 0 := by
        nlinarith [hx]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  have hS : S = ({8, -14} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [h₀, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, hroots]
  rw [hS]
  norm_num"}
